overclaims: LeCun's world-model approach will not solve many of the problems that have plagued LLMs.
Plain reading: LeCun's world-model approach (JEPA, pursued at AMI Labs) will not fix many known LLM problems, such as hallucination, unreliable reasoning or poor generalization.
No decisive results were expected or found by the evaluation date.
